rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act - Ban on Algorithmic Rent Coordination
rules.quote: It shall be unlawful and a violation of the "New Jersey Antitrust Act," P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a. a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator; b. a coordinator to facilitate a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners that restricts competition with respect to residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function
rules.summary: It is unlawful for rental property owners to use algorithmic pricing coordinators and for coordinators to facilitate agreements among rental property owners that restrict competition through coordinating functions involving competitively sensitive rental information.
rules.effective_date_evidence: approved July 20, 2026... This act shall take effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment.

related_citations.evidence: An Act concerning residential rental property pricing and supplementing P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.).

rules.coverage_text: Applies to rental property owners of residential dwelling units in New Jersey
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to: (1) research/statistical analysis not used for setting prices; (2) public rent estimates; (3) brokerage databases that list properties without setting prices; (4) government affordability controls
rules.penalty: Violations subject to enforcement under New Jersey Antitrust Act sections 6-17 (C.56:9-6 through 9-17)
